reason: A visual Git workbench for inspecting repositories, reviewing changes and history, managing branches and remotes, and proposing or executing common Git operations.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中查看 Git 仓库状态、审查变更与历史、管理分支和远程同步，并执行常见 Git 操作的可视化工作台。
summaries.en: A visual Git workbench for inspecting repository state, reviewing changes and history, managing branches and remotes, and executing common Git operations in DeepSeek Harness Web.

capabilities: Inspect Git repository state, diffs, branches, tags, stashes, remotes, and commit history
Stage and unstage files and create commits
Create, search, switch, and delete local branches
Fetch, pull, push, set upstreams, and manage rebases
Generate and execute validated Git command proposals
Provide repository diagnostics and recovery proposals after command failures
